title: Tsushima
reading_hint: Dots are positions read off the Japanese official history's track charts (極秘 明治三十七八年海戦史, JACAR C05110095600, charts No.1-48) within three minutes of the shown time, red Japanese, blue Russian, faint where the reading is uncertain; a ringed dot is the selected ship's own mark. The Chart menu lays 37 of those charts under the map; each title gives how well it fits the coast (km). Times are JST. The coast is Natural Earth's 1:10m land. Hulls are to scale when zoomed in. Drag the map to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom.
